search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dx\int_{x^3}^{x^2}f(x,y)dy$ 的积分次序为[\quad] $\int_0^1dy\int_{y^3}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{y^{1/3}}^{y^{1/2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{\sqrt y}^{y^{1/3}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{y^2}^{y^3}f(x,y)dx$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^1dy\int_{\sqrt{y}}^{y^{\frac{1}{3}}}f(x,y)dx$。
